help.text:
🍽️ Dishcover helps you track recipes and figure out what to cook.

➕ Add food — add a recipe to the shared list everyone can see: name, prep time, category, ingredients (tap existing ones, type a few letters to search, or type a full new name to add it), optional amounts for each one (totally skippable), then an optional recipe and an optional photo. You'll get to review everything before saving.

🍳 What can I cook? — pick how much time you have, tell me what's in your kitchen and whether you can go shopping, then tap any suggestion to see exactly what you have and what you'd need to buy. Shopping suggestions are sorted so the ones needing the least extra shopping come first. If nothing in the list fits, you'll get a recipe suggestion pulled in for you or, if shopping's off-limits, a nudge toward a protein or carb you already have.

🛒 Shopping list — open a "could cook if you shop" dish from /cook and tap "Add missing to shopping list" to save what you'd need to buy. Open the list anytime from the main menu (or /shopping), tap ➕ Add item to type your own, and tap items to check them off.

🔍 Search recipes — type a food name (or part of it, like "ghorme" for Ghormeh Sabzi) and the closest matches appear, or skip typing and tap "🌍 Global list", "👤 My list", "🍽️ My recipes" (everything you've added, personal or global), or "⭐ My favorites" to browse instead. One result shows the recipe right away; multiple results show buttons to choose from. For foods on your personal list, you'll see a ⚙️ Settings button to edit (change as many fields as you like on one review screen, then save) or delete. Tap ½× / 2× / 3× under a recipe to scale its ingredient amounts (numeric ones only — "a pinch" stays as is). Tap ☆ on any recipe to bookmark it (it turns into ⭐) — your bookmarks are under "⭐ My favorites". Tap 🔗 Share to send a recipe to a friend as a link that opens it right in this bot (personal recipes only open for people who follow you). Global foods can only be changed by the admin.

🍽️ See food — browse ⭐ your favorites, 🍽️ your recipes, 🌍 public recipes, or everything at once.

💬 Inline mode — in any chat, type @ followed by this bot's username and a few letters of a dish to search your recipes and post one right into that chat.

👤 Profile — your public/private setting, a shareable profile card, and follow someone by picking them from your Telegram contacts, or by their @username to browse their personal recipes and get a message whenever they add a new one (mute individual people, or switch on a daily digest to get one summary instead). Your profile is visible by default; hide it and people must ask your permission first. See who follows you and who you follow, tap anyone for their profile card, and share your own profile as a link that shows a summary and a Follow button. Also: /follow <@username or id>.

⚙️ Settings — opens a menu with Language, Feedback and Refresh.

🌐 Language — switch between English and Persian anytime.

💬 Feedback — drop a message straight to the admin.

🔄 Refresh — something look stale or stuck? Tap it to cancel anything in progress, reload the latest data and reset the menu.

/cancel — cancel whatever you're in the middle of.

/help — show this message.
